data.name: Hidden Object - 12 in 1 bundle
data.detailed_description:
Play awesome stories with this 12 in 1 Hidden Object Games Bundle


From New York to London, from the 19th century to our days, discover 12 adventure games in this bundle

Statue of Liberty : The Lost Symbol - Investigate the disappearance of one of the most important symbols of the United States.

Secret Case : Paranormal Investigation - Investigate the greatest unsolved mysteries!

Hidden Files : Echoes of JFK - One of the best kept secrets in all history is about to be revealed!

Jack the Ripper : Letters from Hell - Can you clear the name of the reporter Bert, suspected of being Jack the Ripper?

Public Enemies : Bonnie & Clyde - Follow Bonnie & Clyde’s track through the United States!

Criminal Investigation Agents : Petrodollars - Step into the shoes of female investigator Keegan and bring down the people that think they're above the law.

Medford Asylum: Paranormal Case - Alison Ester has been asked to work on the renovation site of a former asylum. She must find what forced workers to stop the renovation. They're frightened by this "haunted" place. She didn't know there would be an even more frightening discovery . . .

FBI : Paranormal Case - James is a young FBI agent newly promoted to the Department of Unclosed Case Files. During his different enquiries into strange cases, he uncovers an incredible international plot that aims to hide a shocking and well-guarded secret…"

Frankenstein - Help Brad to find the parts of Janet’s body, his fiancée, as well as the pieces of the monstrous machine which will put her body back together… in Frankenstein’ manor!

Deadly Association - Nancy Boyle, a young woman without a criminal past has been found dead—half-naked—near her home in Brooklyn. The forensic police inspectors Chloé and Paul are on the case. There's a big surprise in store for them.

Haunted House Mysteries - Nancy Evans is an expert in superstition and modern societies. She's been invited by her aunt, Mary Allen, to spend a few days in a quiet cottage by the sea. What she doesn't know is that, next to the cottage, there's a large, run-down house that has a macabre atmosphere.

Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde - At the end of the 19th century, a monster is prowling around in the Victorian fog of London. He has trampled on a young girl, killed a Member of Parliament, and molested a match seller. When he finds out the terrible news, Mr Utterson ends up discovering that the case is not unrelated to his friend Dr Henry Jekyll and to the terrible individual currently staying with him: Mr Hyde.

reviews.review:
The bundle includes 12 hidden-object games. The games cover a variety of themes, ranging from detective stories to the supernatural to horror, and more. The games included aren’t the most recent ones, but that doesn’t mean they’re bad. First of all, it’s a matter of taste, and obviously some titles are better than others, but since this bundle is often on sale for €0.89, you can’t expect much more. Even at full price, though, the value for money is excellent.
Perhaps the only thing missing is achievements and Steam Trading Cards; they could have at least included the ability to unlock the cards. The total playtime for all the games is at least 12 hours; each game lasts about an hour or an hour and a half, but this varies greatly from player to player, because some puzzles require a keen eye, while others call for a bit of logic. In my opinion, this bundle is a must-have for anyone who loves the Hidden Object genre, especially when it’s on sale!

--------

Il bundle comprende 12 giochi di oggetti nascosti. I giochi trattano vari temi, dall'investigativo al soprannaturale, all'horror, ecc. I giochi inclusi non sono tra i più recenti, ma questo non significa che siano brutti. Prima di tutto, è una questione di gusti, poi è ovvio che alcuni titoli sono riusciti meglio di altri, ma visto che questo bundle è spesso in offerta a 0,89 €, non si può pretendere chissà cosa. Anche a prezzo pieno, però, il rapporto qualità-prezzo è ottimo.
Forse l'unica mancanza sono gli achievement e le Steam Trading Card; avrebbero almeno potuto inserire lo sblocco delle carte. La durata complessiva di tutti i giochi è di almeno 12 ore, più o meno ogni gioco dura un'ora o un'ora e mezza, ma questo cambia molto da giocatore a giocatore, perché alcune cose richiedono un colpo d'occhio, altre un minimo di logica. Secondo me, questo bundle è da prendere per chi ama il genere Hidden Object, specialmente se in sconto!
